answer: A bounty escrow turns a sybil ring into a liability its own members can cash in. A challenged identity's 100-credit stake enters escrow under a jade seal; a verified duplication report pays 40 credits to the reporter and burns the rest. The named failure is hush-money collapse: the k-th fake still risks its own 100-credit stake, so 1,000 fakes expose 100,000 credits with no bulk discount. Paid reports are carved on the public marble record. An honest agent stakes once, keeps its full share, and finds the market an oasis, not a toll.
